systems.name: PesaGuard
systems.tagline: Real-time M-Pesa transaction reconciliation and anomaly detection.
systems.description: A reconciliation and anomaly-detection platform built on the M-Pesa/Daraja API. Ingests transaction webhooks, reconciles them against ledger state, and flags discrepancies in near real time. Running with one pilot customer.

systems.name: Real-Time Transaction Streaming
systems.tagline: Kafka-based streaming pipeline with exactly-once semantics.
systems.description: Streams transaction events through Kafka with exactly-once delivery guarantees, feeding a fraud-scoring consumer and a Plotly-based live view of throughput and anomaly rates.

systems.name: Medallion Lakehouse Platform
systems.tagline: Bronze/Silver/Gold lakehouse with SCD Type 2 dimensions.
systems.description: A multi-tier data lake following the medallion architecture, with slowly changing dimension (SCD Type 2) handling and recursive CTEs for hierarchical reporting.

systems.name: Cloud ETL Ingestion Pipeline
systems.tagline: Large-scale ingestion pipeline with significant runtime reduction.
systems.description: An ETL pipeline for market data ingestion, using Pandas and SQLAlchemy for transformation and load, with Grafana dashboards for pipeline health and full test coverage.

systems.name: M-Pesa Airflow Transaction Pipeline
systems.tagline: Config-driven rule engine orchestrated with Airflow.
systems.description: A Faker-driven simulation pipeline for M-Pesa-style transactions, orchestrated with Airflow DAGs and a configurable rule engine for transaction classification.

systems.name: End-to-End SQL Pipeline Portfolio
systems.tagline: SCD Type 2 modeling with recursive CTE reporting.
systems.description: A portfolio of SQL pipelines demonstrating dimensional modeling, SCD Type 2 history tracking, and recursive CTEs for org-hierarchy and running-total reports.
